title: Readiness Estimator: Skill Passport Systems
definition: Estimates Skill Passport Systems readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Skill Passport Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Skill Passport Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Skill Passport Systems — passports carrying verified skills.

Phase 1 — Prove (credential wallets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (issuing authorities): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (recognition): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and workers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
